newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products unchanged or touch softer.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products unchanged or touch softer.

text.p: NWE oil products were steady to softer.
Gas oil slipped as increasingly distressed supply, including large volumes of low sulphur from the U.S and Algeria, faced a market bereft of buyers.

Gasoline ended unchanged as traders awaited the API data, due out later. Naphtha also finished unchanged in quiet trade with some arguing the arbitrage to the U.S. was not open. High sulphur barges were knocked lower in dull trade while cargoes were thinly offered.
